_comment: Fork-only file. It does NOT exist upstream, so it never conflicts on sync.
'apps' is the subset of upstream's patch-config.json that this fork builds.
On every upstream sync, patch-config.json is taken verbatim from upstream and
then regenerated by scripts/apply_fork_config.py using this list, so upstream
changes (e.g. a new 'source' for an app) are inherited automatically.
'source_overrides' pins a different source than upstream for a given app.
